sophia: Quick RFC follow-up: prototyped a tenant-prioritized probe allocator to reduce kernel churn on contended hosts.
juan: Weights based on latency or throughput?
kevin: Avoid punishing heavy throughput tenants. I think use smoothed p50 + 0.5*p90 so we don't overreact to p99 noise.
olga: Ops note: need eviction hysteresis so a flapping tenant doesn't cascade evictions across kernels.
sophia: Sketch config I tried locally: 
```
probe_allocator:
  window_s: 60
  base_probes: 20
  weight = EWMA(p50 + 0.5*p90)
  ewma_alpha: 0.15
  max_growth_ratio: 2.5
  eviction_hysteresis_windows: 2
  borrow_future_windows: 2
  prefix_reuse_threshold: 0.7
  backoff_on_fail: exponential(base=2)
```
juan: How do we compute prefix_reuse_ratio in realtime?
kevin: Sample KV cache keys. prefix_reuse_ratio = reused_hits / sampled_lookups over the last window. If it's high, reduce probe weight.
maya: Staging run numbers?
sophia: 6h staging on 6 hosts: kernel churn -31%, contended-host p99 -7%. We did see one tenant with a transient throughput dip; paused probe allocation for that tenant and flagged for analysis.
rahul: Rollback/escape hatch? We need an emergency override if a tenant is starved.
sophia: Infra kill-switch exists: /infra/ctl probe-allocator pause-tenant <tenant-id>. Also adding an automated starvation detector: if throughput drops >40% vs baseline and retries increase, auto-pause and alert.
juan: Model-variant warmup implications?
kevin: New model variants should inherit zero or minimal weight until a warmup period (suggest 1h). Otherwise warmup will trigger a spike of probes.
olga: Also enforce caps on per-window weight change to avoid oscillation when traffic shifts quickly.
maya: I'll own dashboards and alerting. Metrics: probe_count, probe_success_rate, kernel_evictions, kernel_churn, tenant_throughput_delta, prefix_reuse_ratio. Alert if probe_success_rate < 90% for 5m.
sophia: Rollout plan: 5% canary tomorrow -> 25% -> 100% if telemetry stable. Test matrix: base_probes [10,20,40], window_s [30,60,120], ewma_alpha [0.1,0.2,0.3], prefix_threshold [0.5,0.7]. Run mixed-traffic sim + small-host staging.
